svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shell: print 30 wide x 30 tall x 18 deep at the middle, open

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the back, 2 mm walls. The face toward the anvil is curved

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to a 36 mm radius (anvil radius plus the 4 mm isolator).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: For another anvil size use its radius plus 4 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the sensor board (Hall switch and accelerometer) with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hall switch 1 mm under the top face; feed the cable through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 6 mm hole in the boss under the pad.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fill with potting epoxy; let it cure fully before use.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Isolator: cut 30 x 30 mm of 4 mm elastomer; it bends to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: anvil. Bond it to the pad's curved face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the pad sits on the anvil side, its top 8 mm below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: anvil top, under the hammer's overhang. The band clamp goes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round the anvil and over the pad's outer face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the pad is fully potted; no wire shows at the top.
